import json,urllib.request,time
base='http://127.0.0.1:17448'
ids=[
 'agent-media',
 'chat-6ac45836-87a0-83ed-bea4-0ad0f99c8982',
 'chat-6ac455e9-bea0-83eb-aa94-fd3dde516c0c',
 'chat-6abf3eb2-40ec-83eb-9f7f-c4a32ad11fc0',
 'agent-pc-control',
 'chat-6ac45fb0-9074-83eb-99eb-397265b228e7'
]
out=[]
for cid in ids:
    data=json.dumps({'id':cid}).encode('utf-8')
    req=urllib.request.Request(base+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/managed-chats/open',data=data,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'},method='POST')
    try:
        d=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=15).read().decode('utf-8'))
        out.append({'id':cid,'ok':True,'result':d})
    except Exception as e:
        out.append({'id':cid,'ok':False,'error':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)})
    time.sleep(0.4)
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(',',':')))
